value.rationale: A natural all-size enumerator on an infinite graph family with cyclic blocks has a closed factorization, minimum-set and total counts, universal log-concavity and a sharp nontrivial real-rootedness boundary. This directly addresses the coefficient-shape interest of recent connected forcing literature and distinguishes two meaningful polynomial regularity properties.
